generatorReproduction.note: Same local FFmpeg build and host, not a cross-platform bitwise reproduction claim.

visualReview.observation: Candidate core/candidate main SDK 5.2.1 Chromium: visible decoded test pattern at 6s, Auto/fr selectors, no overlapping control text.

limitations: DASH-SEEK-01 remains open: paused seek to 6s stalls at buffered end 5.999999; no next video request. Teardown AbortError is subsequent, not proven cause.
Native control passes with matched approximate buffered endpoint do not resolve integrated failures or prove an ArtPlayer cause.
Windows WebKit reports no MSE; dynamic skips are capability gaps, not playback acceptance.
External SDK changes are tested with explicit synchronous plugin.update; automatic SDK event refresh has not been implemented or accepted.
Actual SDK declaration consumers, legacy SDK matrix, devices, 8082 demo and complete installed distribution remain outstanding.
Reports and all traces remain local cache; hashes are committed but cache files are not uploaded.
